title: REC-C5 — Agent API convergence via alias sunset+delete
summary: Shrink the MCP tool surface to the canonical v2 agent API (12 v2 + 29 not-yet-converged = 41 tools, was 63). C5.1 sunset markers, C5.2 shrink sandbox test callers, C5.3 delete 22 alias handlers (split into C5.3.1 client migration and C5.3.2 server delete).

findings_introduced.summary: C5.2 deferred sandbox client wrapper migration; C5.3 must split into C5.3.1 (client) + C5.3.2 (server delete).
m0_03_ebpf_probe_lifecycle_impl fails both before and after C5.2 migration (per a035a3c9 commit message). Pre-existing flake owned by REC-C3.5 Tren B, NOT introduced by REC-C5.
Sandbox test_get_execution_summary_busyloop fails when analytics_tools runs immediately after e2e_connectivity under system load (passes in isolation and 3/3 in back-to-back runs).

propose.summary: Path A-lite. Three slices: C5.1 sunset markers (done, f9fa14b1), C5.2 shrink sandbox test callers (done, a035a3c9), C5.3 delete 22 alias handlers from server.rs and drop legacy shims (closed across C5.3.1 + C5.3.2).

specify.summary: AC-31-1..6 (C5.3.1 wrappers) and AC-32-1..7 (C5.3.2 deletions) all closed. ALL_TOOL_NAMES = 41 entries. Wire surface 63 → 41. toolset_sync_check passes both as a unit test (2/2) and via integration (alias_deletion.rs 2/2).

design.summary: Wrapper-first split implemented exactly as designed: C5.3.1 rewires sandbox client wrappers to v2 dispatchers (commit 73431af2); C5.3.2 then deletes the server alias handlers (commit 350f91c6) without breaking any consumer.

tasks.summary: Tasks implicit in the design.md wrapper-first split. No separate tasks.md file required.

commits.message: refactor(sandbox): migrate 24 deprecated MCP wrappers to v2 dispatcher (REC-C5-C5.3.1)
refactor(mcp): delete 22 deprecated alias handlers and update ALL_TOOL_NAMES to 41 (REC-C5-C5.3.2)

apply.summary: Both apply commits landed. C5.3.1: 24 wrappers (22 spec-listed + 2 extemporaneous) migrated to v2 router. C5.3.2: 22 alias handlers deleted from server.rs; ALL_TOOL_NAMES reduced to 41 entries synced with the live router; alias_deletion.rs regression test added.

evidence_observed: T0 + clippy + workspace check clean (no warnings, no errors).
cargo test -p chronos-mcp --test alias_deletion --no-fail-fast: 2/2 passed (alias_deletion_set_has_22_entries + no_alias_handler_remains_in_server_rs).

next_cycle_recommendation: After REC-C5 closes the agent API surface, the next active gate is REC-C6 — Close unfinished M1–M4 reconstruction contracts. The contracts.toml will tell which sub-cycles still own partial contracts. After REC-C6, REC-C7 is the strict close gate that unlocks official M6 OpenTelemetry correlation + export.
